description: PostgreSQL 18 json operators, constructors, aggregates, set-returning functions, Unicode conversion, and casts
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_json_operations (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, payload JSON NOT NULL);
INSERT INTO type_matrix_json_operations VALUES (1, '{"z":1,"a":[1,{"b":2}],"z":3}'), (2, '[null, "x", { "a" : 2 }]');
SELECT json_array_length(payload), json_typeof(payload) FROM type_matrix_json_operations WHERE id = 2;
SELECT payload->'z' AS first_value, payload->'a'->1->>'b' AS nested_value, payload#>>'{a,1,b}' AS path_value, ('[1,2,3]'::json)->> -1 AS last_value FROM type_matrix_json_operations WHERE id = 1;

SELECT json_array_element('[ 10,  20 ]'::json, -1), json_array_element_text('[10,null]'::json, 1), json_object_field('{"a": { "b" : 1 }}'::json, 'a'), json_object_field_text('{"a":null}'::json, 'a'), json_send(' {"a":1} '::json);
SELECT json_build_object('a', 1, 'b', NULL), json_build_array(1, 'x', NULL), to_json('text'::text);
SELECT array_to_json(ARRAY[1,NULL,3]), array_to_json(ARRAY[[1,2],[3,4]], true), json_object(ARRAY['a','1','b',NULL]), json_object(ARRAY['a','b'], ARRAY['1',NULL]);

SELECT json_array(1, NULL, 'x'), json_array(1, NULL, 'x' NULL ON NULL), json_array(1 RETURNING jsonb), json_object('a': 1, 'b': NULL ABSENT ON NULL), json_scalar('x'), json_serialize(' { "a" : 1 } '::json RETURNING text);
SELECT json_array(), json_object(), json_object(RETURNING jsonb), json_object('a' VALUE 1);

SELECT json_array('{"a":1}' FORMAT JSON), json_object('a': '{"b":2}' FORMAT JSON), json(convert_to('{"a":1}', 'UTF8')), json(convert_to('{"a":1}', 'UTF8') FORMAT JSON ENCODING UTF8), json_serialize('{"a":1}'::json RETURNING bytea FORMAT JSON ENCODING UTF8);
SELECT json_array(123 RETURNING varchar(2));
SELECT json_array(1 RETURNING text FORMAT JSON ENCODING UTF8);
SELECT json('{"a":1,"a":2}' WITHOUT UNIQUE KEYS), json_object('a': 1, 'a': 2 WITHOUT UNIQUE KEYS);
SELECT json('{"a":{"b":1,"b":2}}' WITH UNIQUE KEYS);
SELECT json_object('a': 1, 'a': 2 WITH UNIQUE KEYS);
SELECT json_array(SELECT id FROM type_matrix_json_operations ORDER BY id RETURNING jsonb);
SELECT json_strip_nulls('{"a":null,"b":[null,1]}'::json, true), json_extract_path('{"a":[1,{"b":2}]}'::json, 'a', '1', 'b'), json_extract_path_text('{"a":[1,{"b":2}]}'::json, 'a', '1', 'b');

SELECT json_strip_nulls('{ "a" : 1, "a" : null, "a" : 2, "b" : [ null, {"c":null,"d":3} ] }'::json), json_strip_nulls('{ "a" : 1, "a" : null, "a" : 2, "b" : [ null, {"c":null,"d":3} ] }'::json, true);
SELECT json_agg(id ORDER BY id DESC) FROM type_matrix_json_operations;
SELECT * FROM json_array_elements('[1, { "a" : 2 }, null]'::json);
SELECT * FROM json_array_elements_text('[null, "x", { "a" : 2 }]'::json);
SELECT * FROM json_object_keys('{"z":1,"a":2,"z":3}'::json);
SELECT key, value FROM json_each('{"z": 1, "a" : null, "z": { "n" : 2 }}'::json);
SELECT key, value FROM json_each_text('{"z": 1, "a" : null, "s": "x"}'::json);
SELECT * FROM json_to_record('{"a":1,"b":"x","c":true}'::json) AS x(a integer, b text, c boolean, missing text);
SELECT * FROM json_to_recordset('[{"a":1,"b":"x"},{"a":2,"c":true}]'::json) AS x(a integer, b text, c boolean);
SELECT * FROM json_populate_record(NULL::record, '{"a":1,"b":"x","c":true}'::json) AS x(a integer, b text, c boolean, missing text);
SELECT * FROM json_populate_record(NULL::record, '{"a":1}'::json, NULL) AS x(a integer);
SELECT * FROM json_populate_recordset(NULL::record, '[{"a":1,"b":"x"},{"a":2,"c":true}]'::json) AS x(a integer, b text, c boolean);
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_json_aggregates (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, key_name TEXT, value_number INTEGER);
INSERT INTO type_matrix_json_aggregates VALUES (1, 'a', 1), (2, 'b', NULL), (3, 'a', 3), (4, 'c', 2);

SELECT json_agg_strict(value_number ORDER BY id), json_object_agg(key_name, value_number ORDER BY id), json_object_agg_strict(key_name, value_number ORDER BY id), jsonb_object_agg(key_name, value_number ORDER BY id) FROM type_matrix_json_aggregates;

SELECT json_arrayagg(value_number ORDER BY id), json_arrayagg(value_number ORDER BY id NULL ON NULL RETURNING text), json_arrayagg(value_number ORDER BY id RETURNING jsonb), json_objectagg(key_name VALUE value_number), json_objectagg(key_name VALUE value_number ABSENT ON NULL RETURNING text), json_objectagg(key_name VALUE value_number RETURNING bytea) FROM type_matrix_json_aggregates;
SELECT json_arrayagg(value_number RETURNING varchar(2)) FROM type_matrix_json_aggregates;
SELECT json_arrayagg(value_number RETURNING text FORMAT JSON ENCODING UTF8) FROM type_matrix_json_aggregates;
SELECT json_objectagg(key_name VALUE value_number WITHOUT UNIQUE KEYS) FROM type_matrix_json_aggregates;
SELECT json_objectagg(key_name VALUE value_number WITH UNIQUE KEYS) FROM type_matrix_json_aggregates;
SELECT row_to_json(r), row_to_json(r, true), to_json(r), to_jsonb(r) FROM type_matrix_json_aggregates r WHERE id = 1;
SELECT '{"face":"\uD83D\uDE00"}'::json->>'face';
SELECT json_typeof('"\uD800"'::json), json_array_length('["\uD800"]'::json);
SELECT '{"a":1}' IS JSON, '[1,2]' IS JSON ARRAY, '1' IS JSON SCALAR, '1' IS NOT JSON OBJECT, '{broken' IS JSON, NULL::text IS JSON;
SELECT '{"a":1,"a":2}' IS JSON WITHOUT UNIQUE KEYS, '{"a":1,"a":2}' IS JSON WITH UNIQUE KEYS, '{"a":{"b":1,"b":2}}' IS JSON WITH UNIQUE KEYS;
SELECT '{"bad":"\uD800"}'::json->>'bad';
SELECT '"\uD800"'::jsonb;
SELECT payload::text, payload::jsonb::text FROM type_matrix_json_operations ORDER BY id;
SELECT 1::json;
SELECT '1'::json::integer;
SELECT ('{"a":1}'::json)['a'];
